issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean (i.e., it should return a boolean), but the reference solution implements addAnimal(Animal) as void and the template does not provide a boolean-returning signature. This mismatch between the UML and the implemented/signature (void) can confuse students about the expected return type and what they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across artifacts. Either update the problem statement UML to show addAnimal(Animal): void (and document that it simply adds the animal), or change the template and solution to implement addAnimal(Animal): boolean (for example, returning true on successful add, or returning the result of animals.add(animal)). Make sure the template provides the same signature students are expected to implement.
